buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 2. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 3. Generic Supplier shall ensure that the Invoice is raised in the name of Consignee with GSTIN of Consignee only. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses BID SELECTION CRITERIA (NOTE: Offers which do not contain any of the supporting documents required to satisfy below points shall be out rightly rejected)

1. Pre-qualification Criteria: A) Technical PQC: The bidder shall submit self-attested copies of Purchase Orders (POs), along with supportin g documents demonstrating the successful completion of supplies of the same or similar ty pes of materials to Fertilizer, Petrochemical, Steel, Coal, Cement, Pharmaceutical, Power, o r other industries during the last seven (7) years, ending on the last day of the month prece ding the month in which the offers are invited. The bidder shall meet any one of the followin g criteria: 1. Criteria 1: One PO costing not less than ₹15.92 lakhs, excluding taxes. 2. Criteria 2: Two POs, each costing not less than ₹9.95 lakhs, excluding taxes. 3. Criteria 3: Three POs, each costing not less than ₹7.96 lakhs, excluding taxes. Proof of Execution of the Submitted PO/WO: The bidder shall submit proof of successful execution of the submitted Purchase Order (PO), which may include any one of the following: a. Completion Certificate / Customer Acceptance Certificate; OR b. GeM CRAC (Consignee Receipt and Acceptance Certificate); OR c. Both of the following documents: i. Tax Invoice; and ii. Proof of receipt of payment against the above-referred Tax Invoice, such as a bank st atement, payment receipt, etc. The documents submitted as proof of execution must pertain specifically to the same PO/C ontract submitted by the bidder and must clearly indicate the corresponding PO/Contract n umber. Relaxation in Experience criteria for eligible startup for startup as per Annexure VIII . B) Financial: - Turnover / audited annual reports: Last three years financial audited reports or Turnover certificate from Chartered Accounta nt (CA) as below: Average Annual financial turnover during the last three years, ending 31st March of the pr evious financial year (2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25) should be at least (Required minimum Avg. turnover of Rs. 15.92 Lakhs). The Turnover should be issued by practicing CA with Membership Number, seal and signe d with UDIN. Bidder shall submit audited annual reports certified by Chartered Accountant (CA) or Turn over certificates for above financial years. Turnover certificates should be issued by practi cing CA with membership number, seal and signed. Certificate / document issued by Chart ered Accountant will be valid and accepted only with UDIN number.

In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 years old, the av erage turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution sh all be taken into account. In this case, the financial turnover during last financial year / the average financial turnover during preceding two financial years should be at least Rs. 15. 92 lakhs. i. Relaxation in financial criteria for eligible MSEs 1. For MSEs- Relaxation of 25% in Annual financial turnover shall be provided to the qualifying MSEs. ii. Relaxation in financial criteria for eligible startup as per attached Annexure VIII. 2. Security Deposit: Successful bidder will have to submit the Security Deposit (SD) for5 % of total contr act value within 14 days from receipt of P.O in the form of bank guarantee as per RCF format from RCF’s approved list of Bankers covering the delivery period plus 2 months . SPECIAL NOTE: A) If the SD is not deposited within the stipulated 14-day period, the SD will be recover ed along with Interest from the due date of Deposit from the first payment. The interes t rate shall be the applicable Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR) + 2% or MCLR (6 months) + 2% as applicable. 3. Performance BG for supply: Successful bidder will have to submit Performance Bank Guarantee for same value as that of Security deposit within 15 days from the date of supply of material in the form of bank guarantee as per RCF format from RCF approved banker covering the period o f 20 months from the date of supply. SD submitted in the form of Bank guarantee can be converted in to PBG. 4. Warrantee Period: Bidder shall furnish warranty certificate for a period of 18 mon ths from the date of supply or 12 months from the date of commissioning whichever is earlier against any manufacturing defects. 5. Make In India Declaration: As per revision dt 16.09.2021 of ‘Public Procurement policy 2017’, Non-local suppliers cannot participate in tenders having estimates less th an Rs. 200 crores. Offers of Class-I and Class-II Local suppliers as per Make in Indi a policy can only be considered for evaluation and award of contract. The document ( Self Declaration) should be given on bidder’s letter head and should specify GeM Tend er ID, Percentage of local content and Location (factory address) of local value additio n. 6. Payment terms for MSME Bidders: i) In respect of suppliers registered as Micro or Small Enterprises under the MSMED Act, 2006 and holding a valid Udyam Registration Certificate, payment shall be rele ased on any one of the Treds Platform registered with RBI as decided by RCF. (ii) In case the Bidder has opted for discounting of the Invoice through any one of the RBI registered platforms then the payment will be released on such platform as decide

d by the Contractor. Following document to be submitted along with your offer: 1. PO copy and other documents as per PQC 2. Turnover proofs as per PQC with UDIN. 3. Duly filled, signed and stamped copy ofM ake In India declaration wi th % of local content, location of value addition and GEM Tender I D on company’s letter head. 4. Duly filled, signed and stamped copy of Technical bid and all ATC docu ments. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: 1. The rates quoted shall be inclusive of TPI charges, all taxes (GST also), P&F Charges, f reight, Insurance and any other statutory charges. 2. Successful bidder shall mention PAN number and GST number of both buyer (27AAA CR2831H1ZK) and bidder’s firm/company, etc. on Tax Invoice. 3. Any communication shall be done to e-mail ID: vikrant.patil@rcfltd.com; vbjoshi@r cfltd.com 4. Grievances during Tendering Process : · Any supplier, contractor, or consultant who claims to have suffered or is likely to s uffer loss or injury due to a decision, action, or omission by RCF, may submit a revie w application to the following e-Mail ID : GC-THAL-PUR@rcfltd.com The review application against subject tender can only be submitted by bidder who have a pplied against tender. . 6.
